items.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21
items.q: I knew him since I was there. I never knew him to have a job.

ctx.x: Yeah. He could play. Yanky was a tough trombone player. Him and Yanky and, did that have music? Yanky and, oh, you gon' remember that? Chuck? No. Deucin? Deucin. Frankie Deucin. Oh, that's Deucin. Yeah. Yeah. Then them fellas, you see, could, anything the reader would play, they could play it. Yeah. He's had a good ear, I guess. Yeah. Anything the reader could play, they could play it. Yeah. That's our buddy of Frankie Deucin stayed in that WPA band. He ain't know he couldn't read. Well, he could fake, so.
